criteria.requirement: Implement bidict.relation_patch.relation_diff(before, after) and apply_relation_patch(mapping, patch, *, reverse=False). Produce versioned explicit add/remove/reassign facts with ordered full pre/post relations; apply only when the complete expected current relation/order matches. Validate final key/value uniqueness and return a new same-type relation, allowing cyclic value swaps, additions/removals and exact reverse restoration. Preserve original inputs on stale conditions, malformed schema or invalid final relations; never execute operation strings.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
